newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares drift lower in uncertain market.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares drift lower in uncertain market.

text.p: Italian shares drifted downwards on Thursday, following an easier path trodden by bond futures, as investors waited for details of the government's 1997 budget plans to start trickling out.

The all share mibtel index finished 0.47 percent lower at 9,603 with the blue chip mib30 ending the day 0.74 percent lower at 14,310. Trading volumes were boosted by a large cross trade earlier in the day which brokers said appeared to be a book squaring operation involving a fund management group.
Shares in tv group Mediaset ended 0.13 percent lower at 7,118 lire after the government confirmed that it would extend broadcasting franchises until the end of January.

Mediaset shares had risen earlier in the day on expectations that the government would pass the decree, plugging a legal void which could have allowed magistrates to order the shutdown of one of the broadcaster's three channels.

Cement producers had a good day with Unicem finishing 2.73 percent higher at 10,806 lire and Italcementi ending 2.01 percent up 10,068 lire, lifted by reports that the government might attempt to kick-start a public works program.
Oil group Eni and car producer Fiat closed slightly firmer while agri-chemicals group Montedison, information technology group Olivetti and telecoms firm Telecom Italia all finished weaker.
